body.p: In the non-final Office Action', the Examiner rejected claims 1, 2, 7, 11, 13-14 and 19-20 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Luhua et al. (Chinese Patent Application Publication No. CN110064193, hereinafter Luhua) in view of Mero et al. (U.S. Patent No. 5,810,666, hereinafter Mero).
Further, the Examiner objected to claims 3-5, 8-10, 12, and 15-18 as being dependent

upon a rejected base claim, but indicated that they would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Applicant thanks the Examiner for pointing out the allowable subject matter.
By this Amendment, Applicant amends claims 1, 9, 13, and 20. No new matter has been introduced. Upon entry of this Amendment, claims 1-20 remain pending and under examination.
Applicant respectfully requests that the Office favorably reconsider and withdraw the rejections, and timely allow the pending claims for at least the reasons set forth below.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for conducting the phone interview with the undersigned Applicant's representative on October 31, 2024, to discuss the amended claims, and the Examiner agreed that the amended claims appear to overcome the applied references. Applicant understands that further search and consideration may be conducted.
Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection of claims 1-15 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly being unpatentable over Luhua in view of Mero.
